evidence: H2O and the bis-cyclopentadienyl complex hfC5H4sSiMe3dg2LuClj2, synthesized for ALD growth are used, respectively, as O and Lu sources. The hfC5H4sSiMe3dg2LuClj2 compound is chosen by considering that all cyclopentadienyl (Cp) lanthanide complexes are easily hydrolyzed and oxidized with oxygen. The Me3Si-substituted cyclopentadiene is selected to achieve both sufficient volatility and thermal stability of the Lu precursor. hfC5H4sSiMe3dg2LuClj2 and H2O, kept, respectively, at 195 and 18°C, were injected alternately in the reaction chamber using N2 as the carrier gas and were separated by 9 s long purges in N2.
